SAPI's innovative approach helps partners engage and retain merchants while generating new revenue streams.

long_description: Saphyre provides a patented AI platform that digitizes pre-trade data and automates post-trade processes for financial institutions. The platform uses AI and machine learning to maintain the golden source data, enabling counterparties to collaborate and share information seamlessly throughout the trade lifecycle. Saphyre’s system eliminates redundant manual tasks, such as email exchanges and document collection, which helps firms accelerate client onboarding and readiness while improving operational efficiency. It supports various asset classes and integrates with existing infrastructure to streamline workflows across front, middle, and back offices. The company’s solutions are used by investment managers, custodians, broker-dealers, and banks to reduce risks, avoid settlement failures, and enhance regulatory compliance. Saphyre’s platform also supports STP (Straight-Through Processing), providing visibility into readiness and status across internal and external teams involved in trade processing.
